sql: select 'live' src, strategy, count(*) orders, count(distinct market_ticker) mkts, sum(quantity) qty, min(created_at) first, max(created_at) last from live_orders where created_at >= '2026-10-27 03:02:00+00' and market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION%' group by strategy union all select 'paper', strategy, count(*), count(distinct market_ticker), null, min(created_at), max(created_at) from paper_trades where created_at >= '2026-10-27 03:02:00+00' and market_ticker like 'KXTRUMPMENTION%' group by strategy order by 1,2
